subject.title: improve(diagnostics): surface run startup phases as session-correlated events

question: Should `run.execution_phase` become a publicly delivered plugin SDK diagnostic event, or remain an internal trusted diagnostic signal?
rationale: The intended consumer boundary determines whether core must expose trusted lifecycle events through a supported public subscription and whether adding a closed union variant is an accepted plugin API compatibility change.

options.title: Make it a supported public event
options.body: Expose the event through the plugin-facing diagnostic subscription, add an end-to-end public-consumer test, and document the additive union compatibility contract.

options.title: Keep it internal-only
options.body: Retain trusted internal delivery but remove or narrow plugin-facing claims and SDK surface changes that imply third-party availability.

options.title: Pause the API addition
options.body: Close or defer the PR until a broader versioned or forward-compatible diagnostic subscription design is agreed.

recommendation.title: Make it a supported public event
recommendation.body: Expose the event through the plugin-facing diagnostic subscription, add an end-to-end public-consumer test, and document the additive union compatibility contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans agent runtime observability and the public plugin SDK rather than one isolated implementation file.
